problem:
Find the distance between the vector $x$ and the subspace spanned by the linearly independent vectors ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}},$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -2 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Projecting Vectors Onto Subspaces in Euclidean Spaces (Arbitrary Bases): Applications
